0022600119.text: The Hornets host the Washington Wizards in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams at 2-1 and each on a one-game winning streak. Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa, Jamir Watkins and Tristan Vukcevic. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Hornets won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026.
